queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts
)
SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - ov.avg_cnt) AS avg_diff
FROM counts c
CROSS JOIN overall ov
WHERE c.cnt > ov.avg_cnt;
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY ordertune);
WITH types(t) AS (VALUES ('Stop'),('Market'),('Limit'),('StopLimit'))
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS average_count
FROM (
  SELECT t,
         (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM orders o
          JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
          WHERE o.ordertune = types.t) AS cnt
  FROM types
);
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY ordertune
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM type_counts
)
SELECT AVG(t.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average,
       AVG(t.cnt) - o.avg_cnt AS avg_excess
FROM type_counts t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.cnt > o.avg_cnt;
SELECT o.ordertune, AVG(o.dealcount) AS average_count
FROM orders o
WHERE o.recordvault IN (SELECT ordervault FROM riskandmargin)
GROUP BY o.ordertune;
